books.hero.subtitle: These are all the books downloaded on my EReader, alongside some additional metadata. The way I accomplished this was by writing a KOReader plugin that sends the book metadata to the backend of this website. Check out this project here.
coffee.charts.hero.subtitle: This was a section where I was documenting my journey with roasting coffee. What I would do was that I would roast a batch of coffee, drink some coffee cups, and add ratings for each cup. I would then aggregate those ratings into the charts that you see below. Unfortunately, I've since stopped this experiment because it became tedious, but I've archived my results here if you're interested.
